method: Seven complete JavaScript files read. Original appws.js/app.js executed in isolated Node VM with explicit fake timer queue, state stores and DOM interfaces. No real DOM callbacks, network/socket connections, browser or timers started.
findings: Original onError and onClose each schedule reconnect timer; explicit disconnect only clears connection timeout, not reconnect timers. Two queued callbacks survive disconnect and call connect. Real connect guard may coalesce actual sockets; reproduction establishes surviving callbacks, not two real network sockets.

Original onMsg forwards old task complete message into global-ws store with no task serial or connection generation validation; original backend callback lack of current-task filter reviewed separately. Reproduced state-forwarding boundary only.

Original onFetchedChk checks item.ok only inside if document.querySelector(.card-system-cfgs). Without that settings page container, failing vector check never sets errK, and successful mocked connection writes store-sys ok:true. Reproduced exact callback with failing item and absent container.

Connection init clears global message store and adds beforeunload handler on each init; reconnect schedule handles not retained. StartupID detects server restart only after new connected message, not task message freshness. Source behavior.

System check fetch parses response.json without checking HTTP status or array schema; non-array error JSON fails iteration when settings container present, yet absent container can skip content checking. Source observation, invalid-schema variant not executed.

App console.error wrapper suppresses all messages containing Callback error updating, potentially hiding unrelated callback failures. Observer waitFor has no timeout; waitAll stops at first nonempty result rather than complete expected card set. Source observations.

LivePhoto modal controls query first .livephoto video across document, not scoped to modal; can control list video while updating modal button. Playback promises/errors and timeline range/NaN checks incomplete by source, no actual media run.
Notice close depends on transitionend for removal; no fallback. Notification store updates read-modify-write state and can interleave with server callbacks. No concurrency/browser qualification.
UI helper refreshSize sets position/left/top/visibility without restoring prior styles; poptip timers can act after visibility toggles. Source observations only.
limits: 74/125 tracked blobs whole read;51 remain including media, CSS, docs, full settings/similar and database/fetch code.
No rendered visual, image/GIF/video inspection credited this batch.
No real socket/server/browser/DB/model run or full upstream suite; fake timer callbacks are manually invoked controls.
